statements.statement: No. The browser decodes the image, the tool counts its pixels and clusters them in JavaScript in your tab, and the page sends no request with the image or the colors. Only your settings (number of colors, sort, swatch mode, filters, value and export formats) are saved in the browser; the image and the palette are not. Clear this site's data in the browser to remove the settings. Analytics records only the tool name and the action (extract, sample, copy, copy code, .gpl export, .ase export). The
statements.qualification: Core facts match the code (no network, settings only, image not saved). Added how to remove the settings and the exact tracked actions.

statements.statement: The clustering has no random step. It starts from the heaviest color group, adds seeds in a fixed order and breaks ties by index, so the same image and the same settings always give the same colors and shares. Many extractors seed k-means at random, and their palette changes when you run them again.
statements.qualification: Seed order and tie-breaks match kmeans(): heaviest group, then weight × squared distance, lower index on ties; Lloyd runs to a fixed point.

statements.statement: It is the share of the visible image that belongs to that color's cluster. Pixels count with their opacity, and fully transparent pixels are not counted. Pixels removed by Ignore near-white or Ignore near-black still count in the total, so the shares then add up to less than 100% and the status line says how much was ignored.
statements.qualification: Share = cluster weight / all alpha-weighted visible pixels; ignored pixels stay in the denominator; transparent pixels are skipped.

statements.statement: The tool groups pixels into 32,768 color groups (32 levels per channel, each level covering 8 of the 256 values). If the groups left after the filters are fewer than the number you asked for, every group becomes its own color and the status line says so. Clusters that end up less than 0.02 apart in OKLab are also merged, because they would look the same.
statements.qualification: Changed "visible pixels" to "groups left after the filters"; included-group count is what the status line reports.

statements.statement: The .gpl file is the GIMP palette format, which GIMP, Inkscape and Krita read. The .ase file is Adobe Swatch Exchange, which Illustrator, Photoshop and InDesign load as a swatch library; Krita and GIMP can import it too. Both files hold the colors in the order shown and name each color after its hex value; the .gpl entries also carry the position and share.
statements.qualification: Added that the .gpl names carry the position and share, not only the hex value.

statements.statement: 不会。图片由浏览器解码，像素统计和聚类都在当前标签页里用 JavaScript 完成，页面不会发送图片或颜色。浏览器只保存你的设置（颜色数、排序、色块取值、过滤开关、色值与导出格式），不保存图片和配色。在浏览器中清除本站数据即可删除这些设置。页面统计只记录工具名和动作（提取、示例、复制、复制代码、导出 .gpl、导出 .ase）。颜色下方的「色阶」「配色」链接会打开另一个工具，并把这个颜色写在地址里（?color=），那个页面的浏览统计会像记录其他地址一样记录它。
statements.qualification: Core facts match the code (no network, settings only, image not saved). Added how to remove the settings and the exact tracked actions.

statements.statement: 聚类过程没有随机步骤：从权重最大的颜色组开始，按固定顺序选种子，并列时按序号取前者，所以同一张图、同样的设置总是得到同样的颜色和占比。不少提取工具用随机初始值做 k-means，再点一次结果就会变。
statements.qualification: Seed order and tie-breaks match kmeans(): heaviest group, then weight × squared distance, lower index on ties; Lloyd runs to a fixed point.

statements.statement: 是这一聚类在可见图像中所占的比例。像素按不透明度加权，完全透明的像素不计入。被「忽略近白色」或「忽略近黑色」去掉的像素仍算在总数里，这时占比之和小于 100%，状态栏会写明忽略了多少。
statements.qualification: Core fact matches; fixed the Chinese term 计权 → 加权 (weighted).

statements.statement: 工具把像素分进 32,768 个颜色组（每通道 32 级，每级含 256 个取值中的 8 个）。过滤后剩下的颜色组比设定的颜色数还少时，每组各成一种颜色，状态栏会说明。聚类后在 OKLab 中相距小于 0.02 的颜色看起来相同，也会合并。
statements.qualification: Changed "visible pixels" to "groups left after the filters"; included-group count is what the status line reports.

statements.statement: .gpl 是 GIMP 调色板格式，GIMP、Inkscape、Krita 都能读取。.ase 是 Adobe Swatch Exchange，Illustrator、Photoshop、InDesign 可作为色板库载入，Krita 与 GIMP 也能导入。两种文件都按屏幕上的顺序保存颜色，并以 HEX 值命名；.gpl 的条目还带上序号与占比。
statements.qualification: Added that the .gpl names carry the position and share, not only the hex value.

statements.statement: されません。画像はブラウザがデコードし、画素の集計とクラスタリングはこのタブの中の JavaScript で行います。ページが画像や色を送信することはありません。ブラウザに保存するのは設定（色数・並べ替え・スウォッチの色・フィルター・値と書き出しの形式）だけで、画像とパレットは保存しません。ブラウザでこのサイトのデータを消去すると設定も削除されます。ページの統計が記録するのはツール名と操作（抽出・サンプル・コピー・コードのコピー・.gpl の書き出し・.ase の書き出し）だけです。色の下の「濃淡」「配色」リンクは、その色をアドレス（?color=）に入れて別のツールを開くため、開いた先のページビュー統計にはほかのアドレスと同じように記録されます。
statements.qualification: Core facts match the code (no network, settings only, image not saved). Added how to remove the settings and the exact tracked actions.

statements.statement: クラスタリングに乱数を使っていないためです。最も重い色グループから始め、決まった順番で初期値を選び、同点は番号の小さい方を取ります。同じ画像・同じ設定なら、色も割合も毎回同じです。k-means の初期値を乱数で決める抽出ツールでは、やり直すたびに結果が変わります。
statements.qualification: Seed order and tie-breaks match kmeans(): heaviest group, then weight × squared distance, lower index on ties; Lloyd runs to a fixed point.

statements.statement: 見えている画像のうち、その色のクラスタが占める割合です。画素は不透明度で重み付けし、完全に透明な画素は数えません。「白に近い色を除外」「黒に近い色を除外」で外した画素も分母には含めるので、そのときは合計が 100% 未満になり、除外した割合をステータス行に表示します。
statements.qualification: Share = cluster weight / all alpha-weighted visible pixels; ignored pixels stay in the denominator; transparent pixels are skipped.

statements.statement: 画素を 32,768 個の色グループ（各チャンネル 32 段階、1 段階は 256 値のうち 8 値）に分けて数えています。フィルター後に残った色グループが指定した色数より少ない場合は、グループごとに 1 色となり、その旨をステータス行に表示します。また OKLab で 0.02 未満しか離れていないクラスタは同じ色に見えるため 1 つにまとめます。
statements.qualification: Changed "visible pixels" to "groups left after the filters"; included-group count is what the status line reports.

statements.statement: .gpl は GIMP のパレット形式で、GIMP・Inkscape・Krita が読み込めます。.ase は Adobe Swatch Exchange で、Illustrator・Photoshop・InDesign でスウォッチライブラリとして読み込めるほか、Krita と GIMP も読み込みに対応しています。どちらも画面の順に色を保存し、各色に HEX 値の名前を付けます。.gpl の項目には位置と割合も入ります。
statements.qualification: Added that the .gpl names carry the position and share, not only the hex value.

statements.statement: 아니요. 이미지는 브라우저가 디코딩하고, 픽셀 집계와 클러스터링은 이 탭 안의 JavaScript가 처리합니다. 페이지는 이미지나 색을 전송하지 않습니다. 브라우저에는 설정(색 수, 정렬, 견본 색, 필터, 값과 내보내기 형식)만 저장하고 이미지와 팔레트는 저장하지 않습니다. 브라우저에서 이 사이트의 데이터를 지우면 설정도 삭제됩니다. 페이지 통계는 도구 이름과 동작(추출, 예시, 복사, 코드 복사, .gpl 내보내기, .ase 내보내기)만 기록합니다. 색 아래의 ‘쉐이드’, ‘색 조합’ 링크는 그 색을 주소(?color=)에 넣어 다른 도구를 열기 때문에, 열린 페이지의 조회 통계에는 다른 주소와 마찬가지로 기록됩니다.
statements.qualification: Core facts match the code (no network, settings only, image not saved). Added how to remove the settings and the exact tracked actions.

statements.statement: 클러스터링에 무작위 단계가 없기 때문입니다. 가장 무거운 색 그룹에서 시작해 정해진 순서로 초깃값을 고르고, 동점이면 번호가 작은 쪽을 택합니다. 같은 이미지와 같은 설정이면 색과 비율이 늘 같습니다. k-means 초깃값을 무작위로 정하는 도구는 다시 실행할 때마다 결과가 달라집니다.
statements.qualification: Seed order and tie-breaks match kmeans(): heaviest group, then weight × squared distance, lower index on ties; Lloyd runs to a fixed point.

statements.statement: 보이는 이미지 가운데 그 색의 클러스터가 차지하는 비율입니다. 픽셀은 불투명도로 가중하고, 완전히 투명한 픽셀은 세지 않습니다. ‘흰색에 가까운 색 제외’나 ‘검은색에 가까운 색 제외’로 뺀 픽셀도 분모에는 들어가므로, 이때는 합계가 100%보다 작고 상태 줄에 제외한 비율이 나옵니다.
statements.qualification: Share = cluster weight / all alpha-weighted visible pixels; ignored pixels stay in the denominator; transparent pixels are skipped.

statements.statement: 픽셀을 32,768개 색 그룹(채널마다 32단계, 한 단계는 256개 값 중 8개)으로 나눠 셉니다. 필터 후 남은 색 그룹이 지정한 색 수보다 적으면 그룹마다 한 색이 되고, 상태 줄에 그렇게 표시합니다. OKLab에서 0.02 미만으로 떨어진 클러스터는 같은 색으로 보이므로 하나로 합칩니다.
statements.qualification: Changed "visible pixels" to "groups left after the filters"; included-group count is what the status line reports.

statements.statement: .gpl은 GIMP 팔레트 형식으로 GIMP, Inkscape, Krita가 읽습니다. .ase는 Adobe Swatch Exchange로, Illustrator·Photoshop·InDesign이 견본 라이브러리로 불러오며 Krita와 GIMP도 가져올 수 있습니다. 두 파일 모두 화면 순서대로 색을 담고 각 색에 HEX 값으로 이름을 붙입니다. .gpl 항목에는 위치와 비율도 들어갑니다.
statements.qualification: Added that the .gpl names carry the position and share, not only the hex value.

statements.statement: This 400 × 300 PNG has a navy background #1E3A8A, a near-white strip #F8FAFC across the bottom quarter and a 60 × 60 orange square #F97316. With the default 6 colors the tool returns:
statements.qualification: Recomputed by test-image-color-palette.mjs; 120,000 pixels, 86,400 / 30,000 / 3,600 exact.

statements.statement: These are the exact source colors and the exact areas (86,400, 30,000 and 3,600 of 120,000 pixels). The status line adds that the visible pixels fall into only 3 color groups, so 3 colors are shown instead of 6. No navy–white blend appears from the edges, because the tool samples real pixels instead of a smoothed thumbnail.
statements.qualification: Groups = 3 < k = 6, so the fewer message is shown; no smoothing is used for sampling.

statements.statement: Turn on Ignore near-white and the strip drops out: #1E3A8A 72.0% and #F97316 3.0%, with 25.0% of the image reported as ignored. The shares stay of the whole image, so they still match the areas you measured.
statements.qualification: Ignore-near-white result and 25.0% ignored are recomputed by the test annotation.

statements.statement: Van Gogh painted The Starry Night in June 1889; the image above is a 512-pixel copy of the public-domain Google Art Project scan on Wikimedia Commons. At 6 colors with Swatch set to Cluster average and Emphasize vivid accents on (the default), the result is:
statements.qualification: MoMA and Wikimedia pages were not fetched this pass; the image file is 512×406 as stated.

statements.statement: Van Gogh painted The Starry Night in June 1889; the image above is a 512-pixel copy of the public-domain Google Art Project scan on Wikimedia Commons. At 6 colors with Swatch set to Cluster average and Emphasize vivid accents on (the default), the result is:
statements.qualification: Named the Swatch setting so the listed values can be reproduced; the values themselves recompute.
Cluster-average values recomputed from the local image by the test.

statements.statement: With Emphasize vivid accents off and Swatch back on Most common shade, clusters follow area alone and the yellow disappears into a gray-green cluster: #4C6B93 20.1%, #445C8B 18.6%, #1B1D1B 17.5%, #2B2D2B 16.6%, #6B839C 16.2%, #93A49B 10.6% (most common shades).
statements.qualification: Vivid-off values recomputed; the added wording now names the Swatch setting too.

statements.statement: The yellow cluster's average #AAAC78 mixes the stars with the pale sky around them; its most common shade is #ABB39C. For paintings and photos the average reads better; for logos and UI screenshots the most common shade gives the exact flat color.
statements.qualification: AAAC78 is the cluster mean; ABB39C is the heaviest group shade, matching extractPalette().

statements.statement: This 400 × 400 PNG has a red circle #E11D48 with a yellow center #FACC15 and nothing else. At 2 colors: #E11D48 82.6% and #FACC15 17.3%, and the status line reports that 71.4% of the pixels are transparent and not counted. Pixels count with their opacity, so the anti-aliased edge cannot add a black or gray color.
statements.qualification: 2-color and 6-color annotations recomputed; transparent share 71.4%.

statements.statement: Sampling. Images up to 262,144 pixels are read in full; larger ones are read at a reduced size without smoothing, so every sample is a real pixel.
statements.qualification: SAMPLE_AREA = 262144; fitImageSize scales with imageSmoothingEnabled = false.

statements.statement: Color groups. Pixels are counted in 32,768 groups (32 levels per channel, each covering 8 of the 256 values), the same 5-bit precision as the median-cut quantizer in Color Thief.
statements.qualification: BIN_BITS = 5, 32,768 groups; Color Thief sigbits = 5 (source not fetched this pass).

statements.statement: Clustering. The groups are clustered with weighted k-means in OKLab, where straight-line distance follows how different two colors look. Seeds are chosen in a fixed order (heaviest group first, then the largest weight × squared distance), so nothing is random.
statements.qualification: Weighted k-means in OKLab; deterministic seed order and Lloyd iterations.

statements.statement: Vivid accents. With the option on, hue and chroma differences count twice in the distance, so a small saturated area keeps its own cluster.
statements.qualification: VIVID_WEIGHT = 2 on the a/b axes.

statements.statement: Merging. Clusters less than 0.02 apart in OKLab are merged; 0.02 is the just-noticeable difference that CSS Color 4 uses for gamut mapping.
statements.qualification: Fixed the dead #binsearch anchor to the CSS Color 4 section that defines JND 0.02; MERGE_DE = 0.02.

statements.statement: Code exports follow the order on screen. The CSS, SCSS and Tailwind exports name the colors palette-1 to palette-n and add each share as a comment; the value list is one value per line with no names or shares, and JSON stores hex, RGB, OKLCH and the share. Apart from JSON, the code exports use the selected value format (hex, rgb(), hsl() or oklch()), written with just enough decimals to give back the same 8-bit color. The Tailwind v4 export is an @theme block (bg-palette-1 works at once). The .g
statements.qualification: Value list has no names/shares and JSON has no comments; CSS/SCSS/Tailwind add share comments. JSON ignores the value format.

statements.statement: Code exports follow the order on screen. The CSS, SCSS and Tailwind exports name the colors palette-1 to palette-n and add each share as a comment; the value list is one value per line with no names or shares, and JSON stores hex, RGB, OKLCH and the share. Apart from JSON, the code exports use the selected value format (hex, rgb(), hsl() or oklch()), written with just enough decimals to give back the same 8-bit color. The Tailwind v4 export is an @theme block (bg-palette-1 works at once). The .g
statements.qualification: GIMP 3.0 docs list .gpl and .ase import; Krita lists .gpl and .ase; Inkscape manual uses .gpl in the palettes folder.

statements.statement: The .gpl file is the GIMP palette format, which GIMP, Inkscape and Krita read. The .ase file is Adobe Swatch Exchange, which Illustrator, Photoshop and InDesign load as a swatch library; Krita and GIMP can import it too. Both files hold the colors in the order shown and name each color after its hex value; the .gpl entries also carry the position and share.
statements.qualification: Adobe help pages returned 403 this pass; Illustrator/Photoshop/InDesign .ase support is not independently re-checked here.

statements.statement: Tested on 2 October 2026:
statements.qualification: Dated observations kept; competitor sites were not re-run on 2026-10-27/28.

statements.statement: imageonline.io and Pantone Tools made no network request with the image after it was opened (checked in the browser's resource timing list).
statements.qualification: Dated 2026-10-02 observation; not re-measured.

statements.statement: Images above 262,144 pixels are sampled, so a detail smaller than a few pixels of the reduced image can be missed.
statements.qualification: Scaling drops details; every sample is a real pixel.

statements.statement: A most common shade is exact only when one color fills more than half of its color group (32 levels per channel, each covering 8 of the 256 values); otherwise it is that group's average.
statements.qualification: exact = match × 2 > count in the 5-bit group; otherwise the rounded group mean.

statements.statement: Colors outside sRGB, such as in Display P3 photos, are clipped to sRGB. After the palette appears, the tool reads the same sampled pixels again in Display P3 and, when at least 0.1% of the fully opaque pixels are outside sRGB, the status line gives that share. An opened file is decoded for this check in a background worker where the browser supports it (OffscreenCanvas), so converting a large photo to Display P3 does not run on the page's thread (the note can arrive a few seconds after the palet
statements.qualification: Added the 0.1% display threshold used by gamutNote(); worker/16-row strip details match the code.

statements.statement: Animated GIFs contribute one frame, the one shown when the image is read, not the whole animation. HEIC opens only in Safari; camera RAW files need converting first.
statements.qualification: Phrasing no longer promises the first frame; one frame is what drawImage supplies. HEIC-only-in-Safari remains unverified.

statements.statement: To pick one exact pixel instead of a palette, use the color picker. To see how the palette looks to people with color vision deficiency, paste it into the Color Blindness Simulator, and check text on it with the Color Contrast Checker.
statements.qualification: Links resolve to the localized tool pages.

statements.statement: 故宫博物院介绍，北宋王希孟的《千里江山图》卷为绢本设色，承袭「青绿法」，以石青、石绿等矿物颜料为主。上图是维基共享资源上公有领域局部图的 512 像素副本。设为 6 种颜色、聚类平均色，结果是：
statements.qualification: The Palace Museum page was not fetched this pass; the local image is 512×358.
Six cluster-average values recomputed by the test.

statements.statement: 画面大部分是泛黄的绢底，青绿只剩下 #4E6769 这一种灰青色，占 7.0%。这说明提取的是这张扫描图的颜色，不是颜料本身的颜色：九百多年的绢色、扫描时的白平衡都会写进结果。想做「青绿」风格的配色，可以点这张色卡的色阶，在色阶生成器里得到更亮、更饱和的同色相阶梯。
statements.qualification: Interpretation of the scan colors; the 7.0% share is the recomputed cluster.
Vivid-off values recomputed; the parenthetical names the common shade.

statements.statement: 电商主图、App 图标常用透明背景的 PNG。这张 400 × 400 的 PNG 只有红色圆 #E11D48 和黄色圆心 #FACC15。设为 2 种颜色：#E11D48 82.6%、#FACC15 17.3%，状态栏注明 71.4% 的像素透明、不计入。
statements.qualification: 2-color and 6-color annotations recomputed; transparent 71.4%.

statements.statement: 采样：不超过 262,144 像素的图片逐像素统计；更大的图缩小读取，且不做平滑，每个样本都是原图里的真实像素，边缘不会混出原图没有的颜色。
statements.qualification: 262,144-pixel sample area; no smoothing.

statements.statement: 颜色组：每通道 32 级（每级含 256 个取值中的 8 个），共 32,768 组，与 Color Thief 的中值切割相同精度。像素按不透明度加权。
statements.qualification: 32 levels × 32,768 groups; fixed 计权 → 加权.

statements.statement: 聚类：在 OKLab 中做加权 k-means，直线距离对应看上去的色差。种子按固定顺序选取，没有随机步骤。开启「突出鲜艳的点缀色」时，色相与彩度的差按两倍计算，小面积的饱和色能单独成组。
statements.qualification: Weighted OKLab k-means, fixed seed order, vivid weight 2.

statements.statement: 合并：相距小于 0.02 的聚类合并，0.02 是 CSS Color 4 色域映射采用的最小可察觉差。
statements.qualification: Fixed the dead #binsearch anchor; MERGE_DE = 0.02.

statements.statement: 代码导出按屏幕顺序排列。CSS、SCSS 与 Tailwind 把颜色命名为 palette-1 到 palette-n 并注明占比；色值列表每行一个值，不带名称和占比；JSON 固定包含 HEX、RGB、OKLCH 与占比。除 JSON 外，代码导出使用所选色值格式（HEX、rgb()、hsl() 或 oklch()），小数位刚好能换算回同一个 8 位颜色。上面的局部图导出为 CSS 变量：
statements.qualification: Value list and JSON do not carry share comments; value format does not apply to JSON.

statements.statement: .gpl 文件可在 GIMP、Inkscape（放进调色板目录）与 Krita 中使用；.ase 文件可载入 Illustrator、Photoshop 与 InDesign 的色板。
statements.qualification: GIMP/Krita/Inkscape .gpl verified; Adobe .ase support unverified (403).
Dated competitor observations kept; not re-run.

statements.statement: 超过 262,144 像素的图片会抽样，只有几个像素大的细节可能漏掉。
statements.qualification: Downscaled sampling can miss small details.

statements.statement: 「最常见的色调」只有在一种颜色占其颜色组一半以上时才是精确原色，否则是该组的平均色。
statements.qualification: Majority within the 5-bit group; otherwise group mean.

statements.statement: 超出 sRGB 的颜色（如 Display P3 照片）按 sRGB 截取。色板显示后，工具会以 Display P3 再读一遍同样的采样像素，完全不透明像素中超出 sRGB 的比例达到 0.1% 时，状态栏会给出该比例。浏览器支持 OffscreenCanvas 时，打开的文件在后台 Worker 中解码和检查，大照片转换到 Display P3 的工作不在页面线程上进行（提示可能比色板晚几秒出现）；示例插画和 SVG 文件在页面中按每次 16 行分段读取。浏览器不能按 Display P3 绘制时，状态栏会说明无法检查。
statements.qualification: Added the 0.1% threshold; worker and 16-row strips match.

statements.statement: 动图 GIF 只取读取时显示的那一帧，不读取整段动画。HEIC 只有 Safari 能打开，相机 RAW 需先转换。
statements.qualification: One frame, not necessarily the first; HEIC-only-in-Safari unverified.

statements.statement: 只想取某一个像素的颜色，请用取色器；想看配色在色觉障碍者眼中的样子，可放进色盲模拟器，文字可读性用颜色对比度检测器。
statements.qualification: Localized links resolve.

statements.statement: メトロポリタン美術館の解説によると、「富嶽三十六景 神奈川沖浪裏」（1830〜32 年頃）を含む北斎の風景版画は、藍と輸入されたプルシアンブルーの配色で知られています。上の画像は同館所蔵品を撮影したパブリックドメイン画像（Wikimedia Commons）を幅 512 画素に縮小したものです。色数 5、最も多い色合いで抽出すると次のようになります。
statements.qualification: The Met page was not fetched this pass; the local image is 512×344.

statements.statement: #F4EAD4 37.6%（空と波頭の紙の色）
statements.qualification: Five values recomputed by the test.

statements.statement: 画面の 6 割以上は紙の色です。白に近い色を除外をオンにすると画像の 20.1% が外れ、空いた枠に水色がかった #C4D4CB 7.9% が入ります。割合は画像全体に対する値のままなので、#244363 は 16.7% です。
statements.qualification: 37.6 + 24.9 = 62.5%, so "60% or more" is correct.

statements.statement: 画面の 6 割以上は紙の色です。白に近い色を除外をオンにすると画像の 20.1% が外れ、空いた枠に水色がかった #C4D4CB 7.9% が入ります。割合は画像全体に対する値のままなので、#244363 は 16.7% です。
statements.qualification: Ignore-white result and 20.1% ignored recomputed.

statements.statement: スウォッチを「クラスタの平均色」にすると、藍は #2C4A64 になります。「最も多い色合い」は、そのクラスタで最も重い色グループの色合いです。グループ内で 1 つの色が半分を超えるときはその元の色、そうでなければグループの平均色になります。平均色は境目の淡い色も混ざった値です。ロゴや UI のスクリーンショットでは最も多い色合いが元の色そのものになり、絵や写真では平均色のほうが全体の印象に近くなります。
statements.qualification: Replaced "the shade with the most pixels in the cluster" with the actual rule: heaviest group, exact if a color is more than half of that group.

statements.statement: この 400 × 300 の PNG は、紺 #1E3A8A の背景、下 4 分の 1 の白っぽい帯 #F8FAFC、60 × 60 のオレンジの四角 #F97316 だけでできています。色数 6 のまま抽出すると #1E3A8A 72.0%、#F8FAFC 25.0%、#F97316 3.0% で、元の色と面積がそのまま出ます。見えている画素が 3 つの色グループにしかないため、6 色ではなく 3 色を表示した、とステータス行に出ます。
statements.qualification: Exact three colors and areas recomputed; groups = 3.

statements.statement: サンプリング：262,144 画素以下の画像はすべての画素を数えます。それより大きい画像は縮小して読みますが、平滑化はしないので、どのサンプルも元画像の実際の画素です。境目に元画像にない中間色が生まれません。
statements.qualification: 262,144-pixel sample area; no smoothing.

statements.statement: 色グループ：各チャンネル 32 段階（1 段階は 256 値のうち 8 値）、32,768 グループで数えます。Color Thief のメディアンカットと同じ 5 ビット精度です。画素は不透明度で重み付けします。
statements.qualification: 32 levels × 32,768 groups.

statements.statement: クラスタリング：OKLab で重み付き k-means を行います。OKLab の直線距離は見た目の色差に近い値です。初期値は決まった順番で選び、乱数は使いません。「鮮やかなアクセントを優先」がオンのときは色相と彩度の差を 2 倍に数え、面積の小さい鮮やかな色も 1 色として残します。
statements.qualification: Weighted OKLab k-means; deterministic seeds; vivid weight 2.

statements.statement: 統合：0.02 未満しか離れていないクラスタはまとめます。0.02 は CSS Color 4 の色域マッピングが使う「見分けられる最小の差」です。
statements.qualification: Fixed the dead #binsearch anchor; MERGE_DE = 0.02.

statements.statement: .gpl は GIMP のパレット形式で、GIMP・Inkscape・Krita が読み込めます。.ase は Adobe Swatch Exchange で、Illustrator・Photoshop・InDesign でスウォッチライブラリとして読み込めるほか、Krita と GIMP も読み込みに対応しています。どちらも画面の順に色を保存し、各色に HEX 値の名前を付けます。.gpl の項目には位置と割合も入ります。
statements.qualification: GIMP/Krita/Inkscape .gpl verified; Adobe .ase unverified (403).

statements.statement: 2026 年 10 月 2 日に、上のバナーとゴッホ「星月夜」の画像で確認しました。
statements.qualification: Dated competitor observations kept; not re-run.

statements.statement: 確認したページ（patto-tool.com と imageonline.io）は、画像を開いたあとに画像を送るネットワーク要求を出しませんでした（ブラウザのリソースタイミングで確認）。
statements.qualification: The library node-vibrant is not a page; named the two sites actually checked.

statements.statement: 262,144 画素を超える画像は間引いて数えるため、数画素ほどの細部は拾えないことがあります。
statements.qualification: Downscaled sampling can miss small details.

statements.statement: 「最も多い色合い」が元の色と完全に一致するのは、1 つの色がその色グループの半分以上を占めるときです。そうでなければグループの平均色です。
statements.qualification: Majority within the 5-bit group; otherwise group mean.

statements.statement: sRGB の外にある色（Display P3 の写真など）は sRGB に切り詰めます。パレットの表示後、同じサンプル画素を Display P3 で読み直し、完全に不透明な画素のうち sRGB の外にある割合が 0.1% 以上あるときにステータス行に表示します。ブラウザが OffscreenCanvas に対応していれば、開いたファイルはバックグラウンドの Worker でデコードして調べるため、大きな写真の Display P3 への変換はページのスレッドで行いません（表示はパレットより数秒遅れることがあります）。サンプルのイラストと SVG ファイルはページ内で 16 行ずつ読みます。ブラウザが Display P3 で描画できない場合は、チェックできない旨をステータス行に表示します。
statements.qualification: Added the 0.1% threshold; worker and 16-row strips match.

statements.statement: アニメーション GIF は読み込んだときに表示されている 1 フレームだけを使い、動画全体は読みません。HEIC は Safari でのみ開け、カメラの RAW は変換が必要です。
statements.qualification: One frame, not necessarily the first; HEIC-only-in-Safari unverified.

statements.statement: 1 画素の色だけを調べるならスポイト カラーピッカー、色覚による見え方は色覚シミュレーター、文字の読みやすさはカラーコントラストチェッカーで確認できます。
statements.qualification: Localized links resolve.

statements.statement: 국가유산청에 따르면 「단오풍정」은 혜원 신윤복의 풍속화 30여 점을 담은 화첩(국보, 간송미술관 소장)에 들어 있습니다. 위 그림은 위키미디어 공용의 퍼블릭 도메인 이미지를 너비 512픽셀로 줄인 것입니다. 색 수 8, 클러스터 평균색으로 추출하면 다음과 같습니다.
statements.qualification: The heritage portal page was not fetched this pass; the local image is 512×413.
Eight values recomputed by the test.

statements.statement: 붉은 치마는 그림의 1%도 되지 않지만 눈에 가장 먼저 들어오는 색입니다. 이 색이 남는 것은 선명한 강조색 우선이 켜져 있어서입니다. 끄면 클러스터가 면적만 따르고, 붉은색은 갈색 클러스터에 섞여 사라집니다: #DBCBC4 25.5%, #CCBCB4 21.7%, #B3A49C 14.0%, #938374 11.3%, #ECE3DC 8.3%, #54544B 7.6%, #242433 6.0%, #03020C 5.1%(가장 많은 색조).
statements.qualification: 0.6% red survives only with vivid accents; vivid-off values recomputed.

statements.statement: 그림 속 짙은 머리채와 먹선은 거의 검은색입니다. 색 수 6에 검은색에 가까운 색 제외를 켜면 이미지의 3.7%가 빠지고, 남은 색은 #DBCBC4 30.1%, #C4B4AC 20.7%, #A3948B 14.3%, #E3D3CC 12.6%, #7B6B5C 9.6%, #1B1A24 8.6%입니다. 순수한 검정에 가까운 색만 빠지고 남색이 도는 #1B1A24는 남습니다.
statements.qualification: Ignore-black result and 3.7% ignored recomputed; 1B1A24 survives the chroma test.

statements.statement: 이 400 × 300 PNG는 남색 배경 #1E3A8A, 아래 4분의 1의 흰색 띠 #F8FAFC, 60 × 60 주황색 사각형 #F97316으로만 되어 있습니다. 기본 색 수 6으로 추출하면 #1E3A8A 72.0%, #F8FAFC 25.0%, #F97316 3.0%로 원래 색과 면적이 그대로 나옵니다. 보이는 픽셀이 색 그룹 3개뿐이라 6가지 대신 3가지를 표시한다는 안내도 함께 나옵니다.
statements.qualification: Exact three colors and areas recomputed; groups = 3.

statements.statement: 표본 추출: 262,144픽셀 이하 이미지는 모든 픽셀을 셉니다. 더 큰 이미지는 줄여서 읽되 부드럽게 보간하지 않으므로, 모든 표본이 원본의 실제 픽셀입니다. 경계에서 원본에 없는 중간색이 생기지 않습니다.
statements.qualification: 262,144-pixel sample area; no smoothing.

statements.statement: 색 그룹: 채널마다 32단계(한 단계는 256개 값 중 8개), 모두 32,768개 그룹으로 셉니다. Color Thief의 미디언 컷과 같은 5비트 정밀도입니다. 픽셀은 불투명도로 가중합니다.
statements.qualification: 32 levels × 32,768 groups.

statements.statement: 클러스터링: OKLab에서 가중 k-means를 합니다. OKLab의 직선 거리는 눈에 보이는 색 차이에 가깝습니다. 초깃값은 정해진 순서로 고르며 무작위가 없습니다. ‘선명한 강조색 우선’을 켜면 색상과 채도 차이를 두 배로 셉니다.
statements.qualification: Weighted OKLab k-means; deterministic seeds; vivid weight 2.

statements.statement: 병합: 0.02 미만으로 떨어진 클러스터는 합칩니다. 0.02는 CSS Color 4 색역 매핑이 쓰는 최소 식별 차이입니다.
statements.qualification: Fixed the dead #binsearch anchor; MERGE_DE = 0.02.

statements.statement: 코드 내보내기는 화면 순서를 따릅니다. CSS, SCSS, Tailwind는 색 이름을 palette-1부터 palette-n까지 붙이고 비율을 주석으로 적습니다. 값 목록은 한 줄에 값 하나이며 이름과 비율이 없고, JSON은 HEX, RGB, OKLCH와 비율을 담습니다. JSON을 제외한 코드 내보내기는 선택한 값 형식(HEX, rgb(), hsl(), oklch())을 쓰며, 소수 자릿수는 같은 8비트 색으로 되돌아올 만큼만 씁니다. .gpl은 GIMP, Inkscape(팔레트 폴더에 넣기), Krita에서, .ase는 Illustrator·Photoshop·InDesign의 견본으로 씁니다.
statements.qualification: Value list and JSON do not carry share comments; JSON ignores the value format.

statements.statement: .gpl은 GIMP 팔레트 형식으로 GIMP, Inkscape, Krita가 읽습니다. .ase는 Adobe Swatch Exchange로, Illustrator·Photoshop·InDesign이 견본 라이브러리로 불러오며 Krita와 GIMP도 가져올 수 있습니다. 두 파일 모두 화면 순서대로 색을 담고 각 색에 HEX 값으로 이름을 붙입니다. .gpl 항목에는 위치와 비율도 들어갑니다.
statements.qualification: GIMP/Krita/Inkscape .gpl verified; Adobe .ase unverified (403).

statements.statement: 2026년 10월 2일, 위 배너와 고흐 「별이 빛나는 밤」 이미지로 확인했습니다.
statements.qualification: Dated competitor observations kept; not re-run.

statements.statement: 확인한 페이지(vivoldi와 imageonline.io)는 이미지를 연 뒤 이미지를 보내는 네트워크 요청이 없었습니다(브라우저의 리소스 타이밍으로 확인).
statements.qualification: The library node-vibrant is not a page; named the two sites actually checked.

statements.statement: 262,144픽셀이 넘는 이미지는 표본으로 세므로 몇 픽셀 크기의 작은 부분은 빠질 수 있습니다.
statements.qualification: Downscaled sampling can miss small details.

statements.statement: ‘가장 많은 색조’가 원래 색과 정확히 같으려면 한 색이 그 색 그룹의 절반을 넘어야 합니다. 그렇지 않으면 그룹의 평균색입니다.
statements.qualification: Majority within the 5-bit group; otherwise group mean.

statements.statement: sRGB 밖의 색(Display P3 사진 등)은 sRGB로 잘립니다. 팔레트가 표시된 뒤 같은 표본 픽셀을 Display P3로 다시 읽어, 완전히 불투명한 픽셀 중 sRGB 밖에 있는 비율이 0.1% 이상일 때 상태 줄에 표시합니다. 브라우저가 OffscreenCanvas를 지원하면 연 파일은 백그라운드 Worker에서 디코딩해 검사하므로 큰 사진을 Display P3로 변환하는 작업이 페이지 스레드에서 실행되지 않습니다(안내가 팔레트보다 몇 초 늦게 나올 수 있습니다). 예시 일러스트와 SVG 파일은 페이지에서 16행씩 나눠 읽습니다. 브라우저가 Display P3로 그릴 수 없으면 검사할 수 없다고 상태 줄에 표시합니다.
statements.qualification: Added the 0.1% threshold; worker and 16-row strips match.

statements.statement: 움직이는 GIF는 읽을 때 표시되는 한 프레임만 사용하며 전체 애니메이션은 읽지 않습니다. HEIC는 Safari에서만 열리고, 카메라 RAW는 먼저 변환해야 합니다.
statements.qualification: One frame, not necessarily the first; HEIC-only-in-Safari unverified.

statements.statement: 한 픽셀의 색만 알고 싶다면 스포이드 색상 추출기, 색각에 따른 보임은 색맹 시뮬레이터, 글자 대비는 색상 명도 대비 검사기로 확인하세요.
statements.qualification: Localized links resolve.

statements.statement: Color Thief 2.7.0 (npm colorthief, median cut) returns the three banner colors exactly but gives no shares. node-vibrant 4.0.4 sorts colors into six roles (Vibrant, Muted and so on) and finds the yellow in The Starry Night, but rebuilds colors from 5-bit groups: the banner navy comes back as #1C3C8C instead of #1E3A8A.
statements.qualification: Dated 2026-10-02 observation; Color Thief and node-vibrant were not re-run this pass.

statements.statement: imageonline.io returns the banner colors exactly, without shares. Pantone Tools rounds every channel to multiples of 32: the banner becomes #002080, #E0E0E0 and #E06000, plus a navy–white blend #8080C0 that is not in the image.
statements.qualification: Dated 2026-10-02 observation; not re-run.

statements.statement: Coolors and ColorKit are pickers: they place five points on the image and use the colors under them, so the result depends on where the points land, not on area.
statements.qualification: Dated 2026-10-02 observation; not re-run.

statements.statement: 256-tools 的图片配色提取同样显示占比，同一张图两次结果相同。但它读取的是缩小并平滑过的图：一张由 #1E3A8A、#F8FAFC、#F97316 三色组成的横幅（面积 72% / 25% / 3%），给出 71.2% / 24.2% / 3%，另加两个原图中没有的混合色 #475E9F 与 #CFD6E7（各 0.8%）。本工具对同一张图给出准确的三色与 72.0% / 25.0% / 3.0%。
statements.qualification: Dated 2026-10-02 observation; not re-run.

statements.statement: Color Thief 2.7.0（npm）对这张横幅取到三种原色，但不给占比。node-vibrant 4.0.4 按「鲜艳、柔和」等 6 个角色分类，颜色由 5 位分组还原，海军蓝变成 #1C3C8C。
statements.qualification: Dated 2026-10-02 observation; not re-run.

statements.statement: patto-tool.com の「画像からカラーパレット抽出」は、ページの説明によると画像を最大 10,000 画素に縮小し、k-means++ で色を選びます。バナーからは元画像にない紺と白の中間色 #8B9AC3 を返し、割合は表示しません。同じ「星月夜」を 2 回読み込むと、灰緑の色が #9AA795 と #A0AB93 で変わりました。
statements.qualification: Dated 2026-10-02 observation; not re-run.

statements.statement: imageonline.io（日本語版）はバナーの 3 色を正確に返しますが、割合は表示しません。
statements.qualification: Dated 2026-10-02 observation; not re-run.

statements.statement: ライブラリの node-vibrant 4.0.4 は「Vibrant」「Muted」など 6 つの役割で色を選び、5 ビットのグループから色を作り直すため、バナーの紺は #1C3C8C になります。
statements.qualification: Dated 2026-10-02 observation; not re-run.

statements.statement: vivoldi 이미지 색상 추출기는 같은 이미지를 두 번 열어도 결과가 같지만, 채널 값을 10 단위로 맞춘 색을 돌려줍니다. 배너의 남색 #1E3A8A는 #1E3C8C, 주황 #F97316은 #FA7814가 되며 비율은 나오지 않습니다.
statements.qualification: Dated 2026-10-02 observation; not re-run.

statements.statement: imageonline.io는 배너의 세 색을 정확히 돌려주지만 비율은 없습니다.
statements.qualification: Dated 2026-10-02 observation; not re-run.

statements.statement: 라이브러리 node-vibrant 4.0.4는 ‘Vibrant’, ‘Muted’ 등 6가지 역할로 색을 고르고 5비트 그룹에서 색을 다시 만들어, 배너 남색이 #1C3C8C가 됩니다.
statements.qualification: Dated 2026-10-02 observation; not re-run.

statements.statement: Open, drop or paste an image. JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, GIF, SVG and BMP are supported when the browser can decode them. HEIC requires Safari; convert camera RAW first. Ctrl+L / ⌘L clears the image and palette; settings stay.
statements.qualification: Formats match accept/isImageFile; HEIC-only-in-Safari is unverified. Ctrl/⌘+L clears the image and palette and keeps settings.

statements.statement: Replace the current image with a locally drawn sunset illustration and extract its colors using your current settings.
statements.qualification: sampleCanvas() draws a 960×640 sunset; current state is reused.

statements.statement: Choose 2–16 colors. Extraction runs automatically. Fewer colors appear when there are fewer color groups or nearly identical clusters merge. Images above 262,144 pixels are sampled.
statements.qualification: 2–16 from min/max; 262,144 sample area; fewer groups or merges reduce the count.

statements.statement: Order the cards, numbered preview markers and exported palette by share, hue or lightness. This does not change the extracted clusters.
statements.qualification: Sorting changes display and export order only, not the clusters.

statements.statement: Most common shade uses an exact source color when one color is more than half of its color group (32 levels per channel, each covering 8 of the 256 values); otherwise it uses the group average. Cluster average uses the cluster’s weighted OKLab average.
statements.qualification: Most common shade = heaviest group shade (exact on majority); cluster average = weighted OKLab mean.

statements.statement: Vivid accents doubles hue and chroma differences, helping small saturated areas keep a cluster. White and black filters omit near-white or near-black pixels; their shares still count in the whole visible image.
statements.qualification: VIVID_WEIGHT = 2 on a/b; ignored weight stays in the denominator.

statements.statement: Each card shows a color’s share of the visible image; the bar and numbered preview markers match the cards. Click the swatch for HEX or a value row for RGB, HSL or OKLCH. Shades and Harmonies open that color in the corresponding tools.
statements.qualification: Cards, bar and markers all come from the same sorted cluster list; value formats read back to the same 8-bit color.

statements.statement: Copy a value list, CSS, SCSS or Tailwind v4 / v3 in the selected value format. JSON always includes HEX, RGB, OKLCH and shares. Download .gpl for GIMP, Inkscape or Krita, or .ase for Adobe apps. Files keep the displayed color order.
statements.qualification: Value list / CSS / SCSS / Tailwind use the selected format; JSON is fixed to hex + RGB + OKLCH + share; files keep the displayed order.

statements.statement: After the filters, the pixels fall into only color groups, so colors are shown instead of .
statements.qualification: Corrected the sentence to say "after the filters"; groups is the included-group count.

statements.statement: 打开、拖入或粘贴图片。浏览器能解码时支持 JPEG、PNG、WebP、AVIF、GIF、SVG、BMP。HEIC 需 Safari，相机 RAW 请先转换。Ctrl+L / ⌘L 清除图片和色板，保留设置。
statements.qualification: Formats match accept/isImageFile; HEIC-only-in-Safari is unverified. Ctrl/⌘+L clears the image and palette and keeps settings.

statements.statement: 用本地绘制的日落插画替换当前图片，并按当前设置提取颜色。
statements.qualification: sampleCanvas() draws a 960×640 sunset; current state is reused.

statements.statement: 选择 2–16 种颜色，工具会自动提取。颜色组较少或近似聚类被合并时，显示的颜色会减少。超过 262,144 像素的图片会抽样。
statements.qualification: 2–16 from min/max; 262,144 sample area; fewer groups or merges reduce the count.

statements.statement: 按占比、色相或明度排列色卡、预览编号和导出色板；不会改变提取出的聚类。
statements.qualification: Sorting changes display and export order only, not the clusters.

statements.statement: 当一种颜色占其所在颜色组（每通道 32 级，每级含 256 个取值中的 8 个）的一半以上时，“最常见的色调”采用精确原色，否则采用该组平均色。“聚类平均色”采用聚类的加权 OKLab 平均值。
statements.qualification: Most common shade = heaviest group shade (exact on majority); cluster average = weighted OKLab mean.

statements.statement: 突出鲜艳的点缀色会将色相和彩度差按两倍计算，帮助小面积饱和色单独成组。近白、近黑过滤器会排除对应像素，但占比仍按整张可见图像计算。
statements.qualification: VIVID_WEIGHT = 2 on a/b; ignored weight stays in the denominator.

statements.statement: 色卡显示颜色在可见图像中的占比，条形图与预览编号对应各色卡。点击色块复制 HEX，点击色值行复制 RGB、HSL 或 OKLCH；“色阶”和“配色”将该颜色带入对应工具。
statements.qualification: Cards, bar and markers all come from the same sorted cluster list; value formats read back to the same 8-bit color.

statements.statement: 按所选色值格式复制列表、CSS、SCSS 或 Tailwind v4 / v3。JSON 固定包含 HEX、RGB、OKLCH 和占比。可下载供 GIMP、Inkscape、Krita 使用的 .gpl，或 Adobe 应用使用的 .ase。文件沿用当前颜色顺序。
statements.qualification: Value list / CSS / SCSS / Tailwind use the selected format; JSON is fixed to hex + RGB + OKLCH + share; files keep the displayed order.

statements.statement: 过滤后，可见像素只分布在 个颜色组里，所以显示 种颜色，少于设定的 种。
statements.qualification: Corrected the sentence to say "after the filters"; groups is the included-group count.

statements.statement: 画像を開く、ドロップする、または貼り付けます。ブラウザがデコードできる JPEG、PNG、WebP、AVIF、GIF、SVG、BMP に対応します。HEIC は Safari が必要です。RAW は先に変換してください。Ctrl+L / ⌘L で画像とパレットを消去し、設定は保持します。
statements.qualification: Formats match accept/isImageFile; HEIC-only-in-Safari is unverified. Ctrl/⌘+L clears the image and palette and keeps settings.

statements.statement: 現在の画像をローカルで描く夕日のイラストに置き換え、現在の設定で色を抽出します。
statements.qualification: sampleCanvas() draws a 960×640 sunset; current state is reused.

statements.statement: 2〜16 色を選ぶと自動で抽出します。色グループが少ない場合や似たクラスタが統合された場合は、表示色が減ります。262,144 画素を超える画像は間引いて読みます。
statements.qualification: 2–16 from min/max; 262,144 sample area; fewer groups or merges reduce the count.

statements.statement: 割合、色相、明度の順にカード、プレビューの番号、書き出すパレットを並べます。抽出したクラスタ自体は変わりません。
statements.qualification: Sorting changes display and export order only, not the clusters.

statements.statement: 「最も多い色合い」は、1 色が色グループ（各チャンネル 32 段階、1 段階は 256 値のうち 8 値）の半分を超えるときに元の色を使い、それ以外はグループ平均を使います。「クラスタの平均色」は重み付き OKLab 平均です。
statements.qualification: Most common shade = heaviest group shade (exact on majority); cluster average = weighted OKLab mean.

statements.statement: 鮮やかなアクセントを優先すると色相と彩度の差を 2 倍に数え、小さな鮮やかな部分もクラスタに残します。白や黒に近い画素を除外しても、割合の分母は見えている画像全体です。
statements.qualification: VIVID_WEIGHT = 2 on a/b; ignored weight stays in the denominator.

statements.statement: カードは見えている画像に占める割合を示し、帯グラフとプレビューの番号が対応します。スウォッチで HEX、色の行で RGB・HSL・OKLCH をコピーします。「濃淡」「配色」はその色を対応ツールで開きます。
statements.qualification: Cards, bar and markers all come from the same sorted cluster list; value formats read back to the same 8-bit color.

statements.statement: 選んだ色値形式で値の一覧、CSS、SCSS、Tailwind v4 / v3 をコピーします。JSON は常に HEX、RGB、OKLCH、割合を含みます。GIMP・Inkscape・Krita 用の .gpl、Adobe アプリ用の .ase も保存でき、色順は表示と同じです。
statements.qualification: Value list / CSS / SCSS / Tailwind use the selected format; JSON is fixed to hex + RGB + OKLCH + share; files keep the displayed order.

statements.statement: フィルター後、見えている画素は 個の色グループにしか分かれないため、指定の 色ではなく 色を表示しています。
statements.qualification: Corrected the sentence to say "after the filters"; groups is the included-group count.

statements.statement: 이미지를 열거나 드롭하거나 붙여 넣습니다. 브라우저가 디코딩하는 JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, GIF, SVG, BMP를 지원합니다. HEIC는 Safari가 필요하며 카메라 RAW는 먼저 변환하세요. Ctrl+L / ⌘L은 이미지와 팔레트를 지우고 설정은 유지합니다.
statements.qualification: Formats match accept/isImageFile; HEIC-only-in-Safari is unverified. Ctrl/⌘+L clears the image and palette and keeps settings.

statements.statement: 현재 이미지를 로컬에서 그린 일몰 일러스트로 바꾸고 현재 설정으로 색을 추출합니다.
statements.qualification: sampleCanvas() draws a 960×640 sunset; current state is reused.

statements.statement: 2–16색을 선택하면 자동으로 추출합니다. 색 그룹이 적거나 비슷한 클러스터가 합쳐지면 표시 색이 줄어듭니다. 262,144픽셀을 넘는 이미지는 표본으로 읽습니다.
statements.qualification: 2–16 from min/max; 262,144 sample area; fewer groups or merges reduce the count.

statements.statement: 비율, 색상, 명도 순으로 카드와 미리 보기 번호, 내보낼 팔레트를 정렬합니다. 추출한 클러스터는 바뀌지 않습니다.
statements.qualification: Sorting changes display and export order only, not the clusters.

statements.statement: ‘가장 많은 색조’는 한 색이 색 그룹(채널마다 32단계, 한 단계는 256개 값 중 8개)의 절반을 넘으면 원래 색을 쓰고, 그렇지 않으면 그룹 평균을 씁니다. ‘클러스터 평균색’은 가중 OKLab 평균을 씁니다.
statements.qualification: Most common shade = heaviest group shade (exact on majority); cluster average = weighted OKLab mean.

statements.statement: 선명한 강조색 우선은 색상과 채도 차이를 두 배로 계산해 작은 고채도 영역이 클러스터에 남도록 합니다. 흰색이나 검은색에 가까운 픽셀을 제외해도 비율의 분모는 보이는 이미지 전체입니다.
statements.qualification: VIVID_WEIGHT = 2 on a/b; ignored weight stays in the denominator.

statements.statement: 카드는 보이는 이미지에서 색이 차지하는 비율을 나타내며 막대와 미리 보기 번호가 카드에 대응합니다. 견본은 HEX, 색 값 줄은 RGB·HSL·OKLCH를 복사합니다. ‘쉐이드’와 ‘색 조합’은 해당 색을 대응 도구에서 엽니다.
statements.qualification: Cards, bar and markers all come from the same sorted cluster list; value formats read back to the same 8-bit color.

statements.statement: 선택한 색 값 형식으로 값 목록, CSS, SCSS, Tailwind v4 / v3를 복사합니다. JSON은 항상 HEX, RGB, OKLCH, 비율을 포함합니다. GIMP·Inkscape·Krita용 .gpl이나 Adobe 앱용 .ase도 저장하며 화면의 색 순서를 따릅니다.
statements.qualification: Value list / CSS / SCSS / Tailwind use the selected format; JSON is fixed to hex + RGB + OKLCH + share; files keep the displayed order.

statements.statement: 필터 후 보이는 픽셀이 색 그룹 개로만 나뉘어, 지정한 가지 대신 가지 색을 표시합니다.
statements.qualification: Corrected the sentence to say "after the filters"; groups is the included-group count.
